name: cstudio-edit-clone
description: CStudio - Edit & Clone: Visually edit any website and download the source code locally.
author: sakshamwadhankar

scripts.dev: npm run cp && parcel watch ./src/*.html --no-hmr --dist-dir unpacked2x
scripts.build: npm run cp && parcel build ./src/*.html --dist-dir unpacked2x
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['dist', 'unpacked2x', '.parcel-cache'].forEach(d => fs.rmSync(d, {recursive: true, force: true}))"
scripts.reset: npm run clean && node -e "fs.rmSync('.cache', {recursive: true, force: true})"
scripts.local: node -e "fs.rmSync('node_modules/parcel-plugin-local', {recursive: true, force: true})" && npm install && npm run reset
scripts.auto: node -e "fs.rmSync('output', {recursive: true, force: true})" && babel-node auto.js --presets @babel/preset-env
